fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I’ve let all of the critters know you’re awake.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Well, almost all of them, but word travels fast here…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]So tell me. What is it you’re here for?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]… Mmmm. I think I know what you’re gettin’ at.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Haha, you’re not the first fella comin’ ‘round here to sleep around!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]I can imagine what you may have heard about our little town…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]But unfortunately, it doesn’t quite live up to the rumors.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Y’see, we’ve all got things to do and lives to lead.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Can’t possibly expect us to be bangin’ about all day!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]Who’ll put dinner on the table? Who’ll fetch supplies for the town? Who’ll fix the broken bridge?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]See, we’re just a town like anywhere else.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]THOUGH that’s not to say we don’t have our fun!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]In fact! Now that I know that’s what you’re after, I can fill everyone else in…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Oh, let me fill ya in on how things work around here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]If you see this above a critter’s head, it means they have something important to tell ya!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]If you see this, it means they’re waiting on you for something.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]If you see this, it means you’ve got something for them!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Lastly, when you see this, it means a critter has more to say on the topic.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Sometimes this is where the juicy stuff is!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]While you’re out and about, pick me up some sugar from Maverick!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Straight to the point! You’re my kinda panda dear~

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]And by the looks of ya down below, you’re just my size too!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]He’s the otter by the river. You’ll know him when ya see em!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Why don’t you go around and meet the rest of the folks?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]You look more like a Red to me, Mind if I call you Red?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Nope! Don’t answer that, it’s already stuck!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]I like you Red, I can tell we’re gonna be good buds!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]By the way, didja’ pick up those treats I left ya?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]The chocolates! Chocolate covered coffee beans to be precise!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]They keep me goin’ when I’m slowin’ down, y’know?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I left them on the table with all the other food!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Go back to Scarlett’s House! You won’t regret it.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Ay Red! How can I help ya?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Picking up some Sugar? Sure thing, bud!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]OH SCARLETT HUH? Haha! Sure, right. “Sugar.” Yeah I’ll get ya some “Sugar!”

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]She didn’t tell ya? Haha, that lady’s never been out of sugar her entire life.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]“Sugar” is code for lube! But it’s more of an inside joke than anything.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]But yeah. That’s what she wants! Trust me.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Hello dear~ Did you get that sugar?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]How could I forget about our secret code!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]That’s very good of him, but I actually did need sugar…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Oh well! Could always use more lube!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I’ll just talk to him myself once I’m done with the chores here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]That’s a funny story how that “code” ended up coming about.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]See, my husband is a bit shy, especially when it comes to anything regarding sex.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]He hates it when I ask him to gather supplies, or pick something up from the neighbors.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]So I decided to make the code!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]“Sugar” is lubricant, “Spices” are toys, “Something nice” is how we refer to certain gear!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]It’s a whole thing, I think I got most of the town acquainted, oh hohoho~!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: One could only guess what it might mean.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: A monument of some sort, covered by mysterious inscriptions and strange glyphs.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: One can only guess what it might mean.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Since you seem so curious about some of these runes and the history here, I wanted to give you something.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]This was a guide I made to help in translation.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]It’s a little out dated, but it gets the job done for most of the smaller fragments here and there.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]You’ve no doubt come across little relics, this should help you decipher them!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]No doubt you’ve seen a few reoccurring glyphs around.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]These, I’ve gathered, are representations of areas.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]The nearby surrounding biomes of the town no doubt.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]But what is their significance? What is the purpose?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Perhaps it was merely an early indication of cartography?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]The problem is we don’t know how primitive, or even advanced, this society was.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Investigating the surrounding areas has proved fruitless in this matter.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]You may have spotted a few runes/glyphs here ‘n there yes?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Some of the critters have taken a few as souvenirs, I’ve got quite a few myself.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]To the West of here is an even larger collection of ancient history.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]The ruins have scriptures, symbols, and signs of architecture from long before our time.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]A lot remains unclear about the history here…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]But the fact remains that this place was something special.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=8]Ah, you’d like to hear more about Lanora, eh?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Fortunately, I do have another passage I can share!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]As previously discussed, there were many group-oriented events, involving critters of all shapes and sizes.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]This passage reveals that there were also smaller, private events. Likely for the most devout? A right of passage, perhaps?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Anyways, from what I gather, Lanora would occasionally choose two disciples, often male.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]They’d escort her across the forest, through the darkest of woods, all the way to the top of a mountain. There they would find a hidden cave.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Once in the cave, the disciples and Lanora would engage in a union of the body.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]That is to say, they got… uh… Down and dirty…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]This particular scripture goes on and on.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Like half of the glyphs are about how they switch sides, fill her holes, bathe her in their… *ahem* well, you know…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Honestly, I can’t imagine what sort of worship this was…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Are you sure this was a form of worship?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Well certainly! These inscriptions are rare, you see. Especially for their time.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Writing and record-keeping was a niche task. Only certain learned critters were scribes. So typically, only important events were written down.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Still, quite a saucy ritual… I can’t quite connect the dots…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]… But this Forest was indeed full of “love” before.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: What else do you know about the “Shrine Maiden”?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: There's a bunch of glyphs carved here... No idea what it says.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Yeah man, you’re bound to meet them if you stick around!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]One’s a fox and one’s a bear.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Quite the pair if you ask me!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Then you know how it goes man.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Some folks are great as friends, but absolutely terrible roommates.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Take it from me, man. It’s the dream.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]I’ve got some belongings up there. Do you think you could grab them?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Just, laying around in the snow?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]No no. There’s a cave at the top of the path here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Oh okay, why don’t you come with?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Hmm, honestly, it’s a petty reason, and I probably shouldn’t hassle you with it.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Maybe I don’t need that stuff… It’s probably still dirty honestly…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Oh, Rascal! Didn’t see you were still here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]I’ve got some belongings up the mountain. Do you think you could grab them?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=8]Hey Mel, would you please get me the cookies?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: *Charlotte hides under a blanket or something.*

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]M-Melody isn’t here right now, p-please come back later!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: *Fade to black, remove Charlotte laying down, replace with Charlotte sitting by the kitchen*

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Hey Rascal… I know we just met, but could I ask a favor?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]I haven’t seen Charlotte this excited in a while.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Would you mind doing whatever she asks for a bit?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: I was planning on it anyways!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
Errr, sorry I didn’t mean to scare you.
I’m just a visitor.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
Yeah, I came to the forest a few days ago.
I’m new here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]I see… Do you just walk into critter’s houses where you come from?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Well you don’t exactly have a door…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Wonderful! I’ll make it up to you somehow!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
Honestly I’m surprised you haven’t heard of me.
I thought gossip traveled fast in the forest…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Ah, we’re kinda secluded up here… And I tend to keep to myself most of the times…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Um, I can leave if you want.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Oh, no that’s ok. You just really caught me off guard.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Nice to meet you. I see you aren’t from around here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Red Panda, right? The first time I’ve seen one!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
That’s right! I’ve come to experience
"the love!" of the forest!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]O-Oh! Heh… Well that’s much more Melody’s department…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]And you can take all the time you need until you’re ready, darling.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]But really though, any day now would be great…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]I see you’ve met a new friend?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]I had to make sure you weren’t trying to hurt my poor little Charlotte.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]As I’m sure you guessed, I’m Melody!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]We weren’t expecting guests, or I would have had tea prepared…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Now, what can we do for you?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Do you happen to have Finley’s Stuff?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Oh yes, we put his stuff in a box.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]We thought he’d come by to pick it up but…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]I guess we pushed him too far…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Yeaaaah we definitely took him for granted.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]See Rascal, we were a bit of a handful as roommates…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]But we definitely could’ve tried a little harder…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]… You know, that gives me an idea!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Alright Rascal… I’ve got a plan, but I’ll need your help.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]So, I’ve been meaning to meet the critters of the forest, right?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]And we also need to patch up our relationship with Finley, right?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]I think I have a way to do both!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]But I need you to help break the ice, what do you say?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]No Rascal, I’m asking for your help. Please be serious!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]See, I like to bake, and I’m pretty good if I do say so myself.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]But I’m not good at meeting new folks…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]And the last time I tried, I scared them off by accident…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]I’m willing and really wanting to put in the work, but if you could help me out, I’d be very grateful!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Why not have Melody do it?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]She’s out going and great with people for sure… But we’re both basically strangers to the rest of the critters…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]This would just make things smoother, if you don’t mind!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Great! Well first I need to get baking.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
Of course I’ll help out!
Though I might charge a cookie tax…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]So why not break the ice with some extra special "friendship cookies"!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]These cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Oh, and here’s that special one for Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Give that special one to Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Be sure to give some to all the critters!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]… Hmm, no. I smell other critters on him… Melody?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Yep, that’s right! You know them?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]We don’t really know her roommate, Charlotte. But we DO know her baking!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
They wanna get to know
the critters around here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]That’s great! We’ve been trying to egg them on to do it for a while.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]But Finley used to be roommates with them. We’d all hang every so often.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]We’ll also join Melody on her excursions!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Those were usually to other parts of the forest though. Not in this neighborhood.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]We’d go looking for random one night flings.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]You should join us if we ever go again!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
And Charlotte made cookies!
This one’s for you specifically.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Oooh, man, I do miss her baking…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Aw look, it says "We’re Sorry" heh… Looks like they’re trying, eh?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]Oooh, and look here, they cleaned all my belongings!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Well, not all critters have the same standards I suppose!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]It was a weird lesson to learn, and we never really… concluded it too well together.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]In the heat of the moment, it was very aggravating, but now I can see that not all critters are compatible in terms of living situations.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]On the surface, it was mainly that they were really messy…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Clothes and trash on the floor. Kitchen a total mess.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]I was the one cleaning most of it, and I have hooves! Not an easy task!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Melody would even borrow my gear and forget to clean it! Yuck!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]But what it really seemed to be, was a lack of respect. To me and their living space.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]I mean, you were up there, right? You probably saw the mess.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]Really?? And the clothes on the floor?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
There was a clothing rack.
Didn’t see much on the floor.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]And Charlottes books? Those had to be around right?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
Nope, on a book case.
Alphabetized I believe.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Hah. Of course. They get their act together once I’m gone.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Ah well, at least they seemed to have taken my complaints seriously…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Well. It’s not very becoming of me to let these petty things stack up and ruin some friendships. I should go talk to them.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll gather up Finley’s stuff.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=1]Here you go, darling! This box should be everything Finley left up here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Yes, we took you for granted and were just terrible roommates!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Now now, I also have my fair share of the blame. I’ve never been good at confronting these things…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]I should have tried to communicate more before things blew up.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]But if we didn’t suck, you wouldn’t have to communicate!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=8]And we’re sorry we left things like this for so long.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=8]We felt awful after you left, and we weren’t sure how to make it up to you…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=8]All we could do was hear your words and try to do better…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=8]But we never knew how to fix things…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]It’s fine it’s fine. I should have come up sooner honestly.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]Does… Does this mean you’ll come back?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Uhhh! Well. I think we all learned some important things about ourselves…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]I think it’d be best for me to be on my own for now…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]But… How about we do dinner together?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]I’ve got some new recipes I bet you two would enjoy.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]That sounds wonderful, Finley. We’ll happily have you over whenever you want.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Oh uh. So I see you two have met Rascal, yeah?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Yes we have! Come on over dear, we see you!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: Sorry, I didn’t mean to intrude!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]On the contrary, dear! I think we owe you one for helping us patch things up!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
Pretty sure that was
the magic of Charlotte’s cookies.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]That’s true, I’m really just here for more cookies.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Ah! I knew it. I can’t blame you.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Heh, yes yes, my cookies are great.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]But what is a cookie without a delivery service! That was all you Rascal!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value:
That’s true.
I am a miracle worker.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=3]Oh! To thank Rascal, we should have him join us for dinner sometime!

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=7]Hey uh Melody… regarding the toys you were borrowing…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=5]Forgive me for asking, but I’m awfully curious. Did the big one fit?

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]Oh? Quite the nosy one Finley! I can’t believe you’d ask a gal something so personal…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Haha, ok cut the coy act! You know you’re doing that just because Rascal is here.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=6]There’s no impression like the first impression, darling…

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=4]But yes. I hilted the whole thing.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]But really, for however small of a part you had to play, we thank you.

fields.title: Dialogue Text
fields.value: [pic=2]Ok for real though, where are those cookies?
